purpose: Define platform-agnostic ingestion and reconciliation between live/public sources and historical backup exports without moving canonical ownership away from LOC domain registries.
principles: Platform is a source adapter, not the LOC data model.
Live/public sources and backup exports coexist; neither replaces the other.
Live/public sources provide freshness, current metadata and presentation URLs.
Backup exports provide historical completeness, recovery evidence and content that may no longer have a public URL.
Canonical LOC registries remain the only runtime authority after reconciliation.
A connector failure may delay the next sync but must not break LOC API search or existing canonical data.
Candidate or calculated URLs are never promoted as canonical permalinks without observed or verified source evidence.

suno.rule: Only author-public songs are eligible for LOC3 live ingestion and analysis. Private, unlisted, draft or otherwise non-public songs are excluded from analysis by default.
suno.reason: Non-public status is an author decision and must not be overridden by automated ingestion.

default.rule: Only public content or author-approved content may be promoted from a live source into public/searchable LOC projections. Backup evidence may remain private or non-searchable.

url_policy.runtime: LOC APIs return stored canonical URLs; they do not call external platforms during a search request

reconciliation.ambiguous: keep unresolved and require additional evidence
never_infer: public permalink from an unrelated export asset id
song/media relation from a shared date alone

adapter_contract.note: Adapters may expose platform-specific metadata, but downstream LOC ownership is determined by content function, not by platform.

loc_routing_examples.cross_media_relation: LOC2 relation over canonical LOC objects

implementation.rule: The reconciliation script emits an evidence report only and never mutates canonical registries automatically.
